items.title: Concurrency, Asynchrony, Blocking & Threading Models — The Master Guide
items.description: A comprehensive architectural guide to Synchronous vs Asynchronous, Blocking vs Non-blocking (the 2x2 Matrix), Concurrency vs Parallelism, and Asynchronous vs Multi-threading execution models.

items.title: Networking & IPC
items.description: Network stack internals, socket programming, TCP deep dive, IPC mechanisms, and high-performance networking with Java NIO and Netty patterns.

items.title: Socket Programming & I/O Models
items.description: Blocking vs non-blocking I/O, Java NIO, epoll, the C10K problem, Netty, and how event-driven servers handle massive concurrency.

items.title: Thread Pools, Netty, Tomcat & HikariCP — The Complete Guide
items.description: A comprehensive deep dive into Java thread pools, Netty's event loop model, Tomcat's connector architecture, HikariCP connection pooling, and how they all relate in a Spring Boot application.
